parsed_json.up: Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for molecules linked to document CHEMBL4420072. Join docs by chembl_id to get doc_id, then compound_records on doc_id to reach molregno and compound_name, then molecule_dictionary on molregno for chembl_id, then inner join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles (only include rows where canonical_smiles is present). Return chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
